analytics.metric.repair_ranking.name: Ranking of equipment repair times
analytics.metric.repair_ranking.definiti: Valid work orders are counted based on the repair time; a work order is only counted once and does not represent the number of independent failures.
analytics.metric.repair_trend.name: Monthly trends in repair requests and completions
analytics.metric.repair_trend.definition: New additions are based on the repair time; completion is based on the acceptance time. The two curves are not the same batch of work orders.
analytics.metric.fault_types.name: Fault type distribution
analytics.metric.fault_types.definition: Statistics based on valid repair work orders within the period; types that cannot be uniquely associated with history are listed as unclassified.
analytics.metric.fault_causes.name: Failure cause distribution
analytics.metric.fault_causes.definition: Statistics of work orders that have been accepted and completed within the cycle; unfilled and historical uncategorized are displayed separately.
analytics.metric.personnel.name: Personnel workload and quality
analytics.metric.personnel.definition: The completed amount is based on the person in charge at the time of final acceptance; the unfinished amount is as of now; the score shows the number of samples, and collaboration without duplication is counted as completed by the person in charge.
analytics.metric.maintenance_execution.d: Only generated tasks within the planned maintenance date within the cycle are counted; on-time submission and acceptance completion are calculated separately, and the current results are reviewed.
analytics.metric.maintenance_departments: Manual cancellation of single columns; system expiration and invalidation will still be included in the tasks that should be executed; future undue tasks will not lower the on-time submission rate.
analytics.metric.inspection_execution.de: Attribution is based on planned execution time, and daily inspections and periodic inspections are distinguished; statistics are based on effective submission and review records.
analytics.metric.anomaly_ranking.name: Equipment abnormality ranking
analytics.metric.anomaly_ranking.definit: Statistics and records are based on the abnormal registration time, and invalid records are excluded; subsequent processing will not be repeated and will not be added to the number of repair reports.
analytics.metric.material_trend.name: Monthly trend of actual material consumption
analytics.metric.material_trend.definiti: Only the usage and installation facts are counted, replacement will not deduct the original consumption; currencies are separated, and reference prices are not used.
analytics.metric.equipment_material_rank: Ranking of equipment material consumption amount

The authorization of the equipment and the source warehouse overlap; public, historical unowned and incomplete equipment ownership materials are listed separately and are not automatically allocated equally.
analytics.metric.material_ranking.name: Material consumption amount ranking
analytics.metric.material_ranking.defini: The actual usage cost is summarized according to the material number, and the consumption has not been calculated if it has been shipped out of the warehouse but not used; the quantity is not accumulated across units.
